title: Oceanic Briny Filipino Jackfruit Halo Halo
description: A dense and energizing Filipino dessert featuring jackfruit, nutmeg, and deep-fried ingredients, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly principles in mind. This unique halo-halo dish combines the sweetness of jackfruit with the savory flavor of briny ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the jackfruit, coconut milk, nutmeg, and sea salt, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the plant-based milk and maple syrup until smooth.
Heat the agemono deep-fry mix according to the package instructions and deep-fry the pickled vegetables until crispy.
In a small pan, toast the coconut flakes over medium heat until lightly browned.

To assemble the halo-halo, place a scoop of the jackfruit mixture into a bowl, followed by a spoonful of the deep-fried pickled vegetables, a sprinkle of toasted coconut flakes, and a drizzle of the milk mixture.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve immediately.
Repeat the assembly process for the remaining ingredients.
Chill the halo-halo in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
